name: Smart Sale Scheduler for WooCommerce
author: KrishaWeb

sections.description:

Smart Sale Scheduler for WooCommerce
Smart Sale Scheduler for WooCommerce gives you complete control over your pricing calendar. Schedule multiple sale periods per product with exact start and end dates and times, and let the plugin handle everything from activation to deactivation automatically.

WooCommerce’s built-in scheduling only supports date ranges. No exact times, no multiple windows per product, no bulk scheduling for grouped products, and no way to cap how many units sell at the sale price. Smart Sale Scheduler fills every one of those gaps.

Whether you are running a two-hour flash sale, a “first 50 units only” limited-stock deal, a seasonal discount across a large catalog, or a recurring promotional calendar planned weeks in advance, the plugin executes each schedule precisely without requiring you to be logged in when it starts or ends.

Real example: Black Friday, Cyber Monday, Christmas, and a January sale, all scheduled at once

Say you sell a T-shirt and want three promotions lined up for the holiday season. Instead of logging in three separate times to switch prices by hand, you set them all up once in November:

  1. Edit the product in WooCommerce and open the Sale Scheduler.
  2. Add your Black Friday price from Nov 28 to Dec 1.
  3. Add your Christmas price from Dec 20 to Dec 26.
  4. Add your January clearance price from Jan 5 to Jan 15.
  5. Save the product once. Done.

Each sale starts and ends at the exact time you set, and the plugin switches every price on and off for you. Set up your whole festival season in advance and walk away, there is nothing to remember at midnight and nothing to undo when a sale ends.

Why Store Owners Use It
Manually managing sales across a growing product catalog is time-consuming and error-prone. Sales start late. Flash sales run long and lose their urgency. Price increases get delayed. Smart Sale Scheduler removes manual timing from the equation entirely. You configure the schedule once and move on.

Smart Sale Scheduler Core Features

  • Schedule Multiple Sales Per Product: Create multiple sale schedules for the same product with exact start and end date/time. The plugin automatically starts and stops each sale at the right time.
  • Limit sale quantity: Enable a maximum number of units available at the sale price while a scheduled sale is running.
  • Pricing Across Storefront, Cart, and Checkout: Scheduled prices stay consistent across product pages, cart, and checkout using WooCommerce pricing filters.
  • Support for Simple, Variable, and Grouped Products: Works with simple, variable, and grouped WooCommerce products.
  • Conflict Detection with Live Status: Automatically detects overlapping or duplicate sale schedules and alerts you before saving.
  • Increase Price Scheduler: Schedule future regular price increases or updates with exact date and time controls.
  • HPOS Compatible and REST API Ready: Compatible with WooCommerce HPOS, REST API, and headless WooCommerce setups.
  • Email Reports before scheduled: Receive daily email summaries of products scheduled to go on sale the next day.

Pro Features

  • Sale Scheduler Dashboard: Manage and monitor all active, scheduled, and expired sales from a centralized dashboard.
  • Sale Price Management: View, edit, delete, filter, and manage WooCommerce sale schedules from a single screen.
  • Import / Export Sale Data: Import or export sale schedules using CSV files for easier bulk management and migration.
  • Global Price Adjustments: Apply bulk price increases or discounts across categories, brands, or product attributes automatically.
  • Premium support and feature updates: Get access to premium support via email and chat.

Perfect for

  • Black Friday and Cyber Monday campaigns planned weeks ahead
  • Christmas, New Year, and other seasonal promotions
  • Two-hour flash sales that start and end to the exact minute
  • Limited-stock flash deals, such as “first 50 units at 40% off”
  • Festival and holiday sales across your whole calendar
  • Scheduled price increases for peak-demand periods
  • Any store that wants to set promotions once and forget them

How It Compares to WooCommerce Native Scheduling

WooCommerce lets you attach a sale price to a start and end date. That is where the built-in feature stops. Smart Sale Scheduler adds exact-time precision, multiple sale windows per product, variation-level control, grouped product bulk scheduling, conflict detection, scheduled regular price increases, and quantity-limited sale pricing with automatic stop and split cart pricing. All of which WooCommerce does not support natively.

Smart Sale Quantity Limit

Limit the number of units customers can buy at the sale price, ideal for “first 50 units only” flash deals and limited-stock promotions. The settings appear in the Inventory tab of the product edit screen under Smart Sale Quantity Limit, for simple products and for each variation.

  • Sale quantity: Set how many units can be sold at the sale price. The value can never exceed the product’s stock quantity and shows the remaining sale units as orders come in.
  • Allow regular price sales: When enabled, remaining stock can still be bought at the regular price once the sale quantity is used up. When disabled, the product shows as out of stock until the sale ends or the limit is refilled.
  • Split pricing in cart: If a customer adds more units than remain at the sale price, the remaining sale units are charged at the sale price and the rest at the regular price, with a clear notice on the cart and checkout pages.
  • Variation-level and shared limits: Set a limit on an individual variation, or on the parent variable product to share one limit across all its variations.
  • Safe concurrent checkouts: Checkouts are serialised so two customers cannot both claim the last sale units. If the available quantity changes during checkout, the customer is notified to review their cart. Works with both the classic and block (Store API) checkout.
  • Automatic stop and admin email: When the limit is reached, the sale price stops automatically and the site admin receives an email with the product, the configured limit and the quantity sold.
  • Restore on cancel, refund, or failure: Units from cancelled, refunded, or failed orders are returned to the sale quantity while the same sale is still running, and the sale resumes if units become available again.

Notes

  • Core WooCommerce sale fields still take precedence in these scenarios:

    1. A sale price exists without both start and end dates
    2. A sale price exists and its date range includes the current date

  • After changing the site timezone, re-save scheduled sales to realign datetimes.

  • Use sssw_get_product_ids_on_sale() for accurate sale-product lookups with SSSW.

Developer Notes

  • Use sssw_get_product_ids_on_sale() instead of wc_get_product_ids_on_sale()
  • sssw_get_product_ids_on_sale() returns all products on sale, including SSSW-scheduled sales; wc_get_product_ids_on_sale() only returns core sale products
  • Prices are enforced via filters on woocommerce_product_get_price, variations, and cart calculations
  • Real-time activation runs on multiple hooks and via wp_ajax_sssw_check_sale_activation
  • Smart Sale Quantity Limit tracks sold units per sale, serialises checkouts to prevent overselling at the sale price, and restores units on cancelled, refunded, or failed orders
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin via WordPress admin or upload to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress
  3. Edit a product in WooCommerce to start scheduling sales
  4. Use the new buttons in Product Data to open Sale Scheduler or Increase Price Scheduler
  5. For variable products, manage schedules per-variation; for grouped products, use bulk apply
sections.faq:
Does Smart Sale Scheduler replace WooCommerce’s built-in sale scheduling?

No. It extends WooCommerce’s native sale system. Core sale fields continue working normally, and native WooCommerce pricing takes priority whenever its sale price and date range are active.

Can I schedule more than one sale for the same product?

Yes. You can create unlimited future sale windows for a single product, each with its own start date, start time, end date, and end time. They activate automatically in sequence.

Does it work with variable products and individual variations?

Yes. Every variation can have its own independent schedule. You can run sales on specific sizes or colours while others remain at full price, with automatic overlap conflict alerts.

Can I schedule a regular price increase instead of a sale?

Yes. You can set a new base price and define the exact date and time it should apply. The price updates automatically even if you’re offline.

How does it handle grouped products?

Apply a schedule to the grouped product parent and it automatically cascades to all child products, saving time and manual work.

What is the SSSW Email Reports addon?

It’s an optional addon that sends a daily HTML email to store admins summarizing products scheduled to go on sale the next day, including titles, SKUs, and prices.

Can I limit how many units are sold at the sale price?

Yes. Enable “Limit sale quantity” in the product’s Inventory tab and set the sale quantity. When the limit is reached the sale stops automatically and you receive an email. Turn on “Allow regular price sales” to keep selling the remaining stock at the regular price.

What happens if a customer buys more units than remain at the sale price?

The cart splits the price: the remaining sale units are charged at the sale price and the extra units at the regular price, with a clear notice at cart and checkout. If regular price sales are not allowed, the cart quantity is capped at the remaining sale units.

Will it conflict with existing WooCommerce sale prices?

No. WooCommerce native sale logic always takes precedence. Existing native sales continue working without interference.

I have an idea for a great way to improve this plugin

Great! I’d love to hear from you at support@krishaweb.com

Can I schedule Black Friday, Christmas, and a January sale at the same time?

Yes. This is exactly what Smart Sale Scheduler is built for. Add as many sale windows as you need on a single product, each with its own start and end date and time, and save once. The plugin runs each promotion automatically on schedule, so you can set up your entire holiday calendar in advance and leave it alone.

Can I schedule a two-hour flash sale that starts and ends at an exact time?

Yes. Every scheduled sale has a start and end time down to the minute, not just a date. Your flash sale begins and ends precisely when you plan, even if you are not logged in.
sections.changelog:
1.3

  • Smart Sale Quantity Limit to cap the number of units sold at the sale price, for simple products and variations.
  • Option to continue selling remaining stock at the regular price once the sale quantity is used up.
  • Split pricing in cart and checkout when the cart quantity exceeds the remaining sale units.
  • Automatic sale stop and admin email notification when the sale quantity limit is reached.
  • Sale quantity is restored when an order is cancelled, refunded, or failed while the sale is running.
  • Various bug fixes and UI improvements.

1.2

  • UI improvements on sale scheduler on product edit page.

1.1

  • Variation products sale price bug fixing

1.0

  • HPOS compatibility declaration
  • Cart/checkout price enforcement and display integration
  • Variation scheduler UI with conflict checks and live indicator
  • Grouped products bulk apply tool
  • Increase Price Scheduler (simple and variations)
  • Weekly maintenance cleanup for very old expired sales
